type.description: Select the type of change that you're committing

scope.description: What is the scope of this change (optional)? Scopes: contract, backend, sdk, frontend, ci, docs, deps

subject.description: Write a short, imperative tense description of the change

body.description: Provide a longer description of the changes (optional)
